quests.title: The Floral Courtyard: Part I

dialogue.t: Good day, you two.
Ah, a fragrance wafts from the two of you. You must both be connoisseurs of the finer things in life...
Huh. Do we smell that nice, {NICKNAME}? Let Paimon try...
Oooh, you do smell of Matsutake Meat Rolls! Guess this lady's right on the Mora, huh?

dialogue.sit: I don't think she's talking about that kind of fragrance, Paimon...
Paimon, I think you're missing the point...

dialogue.t: That's true. And with this familiar opening... Ooh, Paimon gets it! Is this lady gonna need our help as well?
Indeed, I believe that you will serve as dutiful guides and bring more customers in, but I'd prefer that you be able to enjoy this festival as a customer.
Would you two like to give it a try if you have time? Creating a "floral courtyard" of your very own, that is.
What's a "floral courtyard"?

dialogue.sit: Sure, I'd like to find out.

dialogue.t: As you can see, I am a florist. The arrangement of these flower stands behind me is the "floral courtyard" — arranged according to the principles of "ikebana."

To place carefully trimmed flowers into their respective vessels and add on various accessories to create a courtyard-like scene on the table. This is the "floral courtyard" — the crystallization of the floral arts.

With the aid of the Yashiro Commission, I am taking part in the Irodori Festival with a variety of "floral courtyards," in the hopes that we might introduce the beauty of the floral arts to our guests.
If you're interested, please feel free to give it a go.
Huh... These floral artworks really are super pretty, and they look really elegant too. But it looks tough. Can we really do it?

dialogue.sit: Worried about your handicraft skills, Paimon?
Too used to doing things in large strides, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Please do not worry.
To help our guests truly appreciate the charm of this art, I have prepared a great number of items that can simplify the construction process.
You just need to select the main flower, the floral scene, and the base, before combining these elements to create your very own "floral courtyard."
Of course, the important thing is to experience "expressing yourself through the floral arts." As such, I will give you four "floral themes" to test your thinking a little.
If you complete the theme on each day, you will be able to take the corresponding "floral courtyards" and flowers back with you as mementos, along with some extra prizes.
Really? That's awesome!
Hehe, come on, {NICKNAME}, since this lady's put in so much effort, let's lend her a hand, shall we?

dialogue.sit: We'll do it for the beauty of the floral arts...
We'll do it for the extra prizes...

dialogue.t: Alright then, let's start now! Let's make our own... Uh, what was it again? Right! Our very own "floral courtyards"!
Hahaha. You have my thanks for your enthusiasm...
Well, then let's begin, shall we? The theme for today is "The purple sakura lies sparse, the clear sand is fragrant."
Ponder the meaning of this theme, and focus on the flowers and the various other utensils to create your very own "floral courtyard."
In the following days, I will continue to stay here and guide those who come for the Irodori Festival, and help them to enjoy the beauty of the "floral courtyards."
Don't forget to drop by every day to get another "theme." There will be a total of four such themes for you to figure out.
Of course, if you have any other questions, I will do my best to answer them for you.

dialogue.sit: I have no further questions at the moment.

dialogue.t: The flowers I use are all provided by Sakuya's Flowers. The flowers they grow are of impeccable quality and affordable prices.
Perhaps you've met Sakuya as well. We once studied ikebana under the same master.

Sakuya is also very well-studied in the floral arts, but when she heard that there would be tons of people at the Irodori Festival, she seemed to have gotten a bit of stage fright. She said that it would be difficult to quiet down and focus on her work in such an environment.
In any case, I will advertise Sakuya's Flowers on her behalf.
We can help too if you need us!
Well then, do the two of you have any other questions?
Think nothing of it. If you have time, you can come and look for me any time.

quests.description: Amidst the Irodori Festival, the florist Fushizome is looking for someone to experience the art of ikebana.
